00067 void LFPulseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 { 
00069  double reciprocalSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00070  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00071  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00072  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00073  float* dutySamples = inputs[Duty].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00074  
00075  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00076  {
00077   float out;
00078   
00079   if(currentPhase >= 1.f) {
00080    currentPhase -= 1.f;
00081    out = *dutySamples++ < 0.5f ? 1.f : 0.f;
00082   } else {
00083    out = currentPhase < *dutySamples++ ? 1.f : 0.f;
00084   }
00085   
00086   currentPhase += *freqSamples++ * reciprocalSampleRate;
00087   *outputSamples++ = out;
00088  }
00089 }

00098 void LFPulseUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00099 { 
00100  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00101  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00102  double krBlockSizeOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * krBlockSize;
00103  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00104  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00105  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00106  float* dutySamples = inputs[Duty].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00107  
00108  int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00109  
00110  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00111  {
00112   float nextValue = value;
00113   
00114   if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00115   {
00116    float out;
00117    
00118    if(currentPhase >= 1.f) {
00119     currentPhase -= 1.f;
00120     out = *dutySamples < 0.5f ? 1.f : 0.f;
00121    } else {
00122     out = currentPhase < *dutySamples ? 1.f : 0.f;
00123    }
00124    
00125    currentPhase += *freqSamples * krBlockSizeOverSampleRate;
00126    nextValue = out;
00127   }
00128   
00129   numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00130   
00131   blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00132   freqSamples   += numKrSamples;
00133   dutySamples   += numKrSamples;
00134   
00135   if(value == nextValue)
00136   {
00137    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00138    {
00139     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00140     --numSamplesToProcess;
00141     --numKrSamples;
00142    }
00143   }
00144   else
00145   {
00146    float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00147    
00148    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00149    {
00150     *outputSamples++ = value;
00151     value += valueSlope;
00152     --numSamplesToProcess;
00153     --numKrSamples;
00154    }
00155    
00156    value = nextValue;
00157   }
00158  }
00159 }
